home.title: Library
home.intro: Your firm's measuring knowledge, as data you own: rule sets, classifications and dictionaries, versioned and shared by every project.
home.projectIntro: Presets that belong to this project only, such as its own dictionary or a patch on a company rule set.
home.emptyProject: This project has no presets of its own.

preset.draftProblems: Draft · {n, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}}
preset.archivedNote: This preset is archived: it is hidden from pickers and can't be edited. BoQs that used it keep their numbers.
preset.detailsHint: The name and notes people see in the Library and in the BoQ setup.
preset.archiveBody: It disappears from the Library and from every picker. BoQs and saved versions that used it keep their numbers and their copy of it.

create.name: Name
create.basedOnHint: Free text, for your own reference, e.g. the rulebook you follow. boqlet doesn't check it against any standard.

modeHints.empty: Start with nothing and add what you need.
modeHints.copy: An independent copy of a version. Later changes to the original don't reach it.
modeHints.patch: Store only your changes. It follows the original's future versions.

create.notAllowed: You can view and pick presets here, but creating them is for library editors (and, in a project, its leads and estimators).

edit.draftOver: Version {n} stays in use until the draft is published.
edit.noDraft: Version {n} is the latest. Your first change starts a draft; version {n} stays in use until the draft is published.
edit.system: System presets are read-only. Make a copy to change one.
edit.discardBody: Its changes are lost. The published versions stay as they are.
edit.discardBodyNoVersion: Its changes are lost. The preset has no published version, so it stays empty until you start again.
edit.readOnly: Read-only. Library editors change company presets; a project's leads and estimators change its own.
edit.problems: {n, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} to fix before publishing
edit.problemsHint: Found by the engine's check when the draft was saved.
edit.statusIdle: Changes are saved as you go.
edit.statusConflict: Not saved: the draft changed elsewhere.
edit.conflictBody: The draft was saved in another tab or by a colleague after you opened it. Load their version (your unsaved changes are lost) or save yours over it.

versions.hint: Published versions never change. Tick two to compare them.
versions.readOnly: Read-only. Restore it as a draft to work from it.
versions.restoreBody: The current draft is replaced by version {n}'s document.
versions.diffSame: The two versions are the same.
versions.diffSummary: {added, plural, one {# line added} other {# lines added}}, {removed, plural, one {# line removed} other {# lines removed}}
versions.diffSkip: {n, plural, one {# unchanged line} other {# unchanged lines}}

usage.none: No BoQ uses this preset yet.

start.net: net, the model's openings taken out

deductWhat.voids: holes without a door or window

deductModes.over_threshold: only those larger than a size, in full
deductModes.excess_only: only the part above a size
deductModes.per_element_sum: all, when together they exceed a size

nameGroups.lists: Lists (use with SUM, COUNT, MIN, MAX, AVG)
nameGroups.items: Fields of list items (inside WHERE, or after a list: Openings › Area)
nameGroups.line: On a BoQ line (calculated items per line)
nameGroups.building: The whole building (after Building ›, e.g. [Building › Gross volume])

functions.text: IF(condition, then, else) MIN MAX ROUND(x, step) CEIL FLOOR ABS SQRT PI() COALESCE UNDER(term, "root") CONTAINS(text, "x") LOWER

lists.text: SUM([Openings › Area] WHERE [Area] > 0.5) · COUNT([Openings] WHERE [Opening kind] = "door") · also AVG, MIN, MAX

names.text: In square brackets, as listed under Names. Text in quotes is taken as written. Checked and calculated only by the engine.

fields.codeTitle: Show the formula exactly as stored
fields.propertySets: Property sets: props["Pset_WallCommon.FireRating"]. A value the element doesn't have counts as empty.
fields.useSlot: Take this value from a setting

json.note: The draft exactly as it is saved. Edit and apply; the forms update from it.
json.label: Document as JSON

preview.title: Preview
preview.follow: Follow my changes (runs again after each save)
preview.hint: Pick a model version to see the BoQ lines this draft gives, and what it changes against the published version.
preview.summary: {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}, {questions, plural, =0 {no questions} one {# question} other {# questions}}.
preview.noCompare: Nothing published yet to compare with.

publish.title: Publish {name} as version {n}
publish.body: Version {n} can't be changed afterwards. BoQs keep the version they use until someone picks the new one.
publish.noteHint: Shown in the version history, e.g. "Openings up to 0.5 m² stay in walls".
publish.problems: {n, plural, one {The draft has a problem} other {The draft has # problems}} to fix first (listed above the editor).
publish.conflict: The draft changed elsewhere. Reload or keep yours first.

clone.title: Clone {name}
clone.name: Name
clone.body: A copy in your company's Library, as a draft. Later changes to the original don't reach it.
clone.bodyRuleSet: A new rule set in your company's Library, as a draft.

modeHints.patch: Stores only your changes and follows the original's future versions.
modeHints.copy: A full copy. Later changes to the original don't reach it.

template.changes: {n, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} to apply to the draft. Nothing is saved until you apply.
template.noChanges: The workbook changes nothing in the draft.
template.problems: {n, plural, one {# row couldn't be read} other {# rows couldn't be read}}
template.problemsHint: Rows with a problem are left out. Fix them in Excel and upload again, or apply the rest.
